Break disables the passive magic resistance.
Creates a blinked fragment of Anti-Mage next to the enemy caster upon reflecting their unit-targeted spell while active.

tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_antimage_mana_void_: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies.  The main target is also mini-stunned.

Passively grants attack damage when an enemy hero's mana falls below %min_bonus_pct%%%, with the bonuses increasing as their mana falls further.

If the enemies mana falls below %threshold_pct%%% Anti-Mage gains the maximum amount of damage, as well as vision and True Sight of that hero. Applies to enemy heroes within %thirst_range% range. Bonuses stack per hero.
After bringing enemies to their knees, Anti-Mage punishes them for their use of the arcane arts.
Damage is calculated based on the primary target's mana, but applied to all enemies within the area of effect.

tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_antimage_counterspe: Counterspell Ally may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around an allied hero that blocks and reflects any targeted spells. Any time a spell is blocked by Counterspell or Counterspell Ally, an illusion of Anti-Mage will be created next to the enemy.

Counterspell burns a percentage of the countered spell's mana cost from its caster and does damage based on %damage_from_mana_drain_percent%%% of the burned mana cost, up to a maximum of %max_damage_from_mana_drain% damage per reflected spell.
The only magic that Anti-Mage will even barely tolerate... is friendship.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_antimage_bio: The monks of Turstarkuri watched the rugged valleys below their mountain monastery as wave after wave of invaders swept through the lower kingdoms. Ascetic and pragmatic, in their remote monastic eyrie they remained aloof from mundane strife, wrapped in meditation that knew no gods or elements of magic. Then came the Legion of the Dead God, crusaders with a sinister mandate to replace all local worship with their Unliving Lord's poisonous nihilosophy. From a landscape that had known nothing but blood and battle for a thousand years, they tore the souls and bones of countless fallen legions and pitched them against Turstarkuri. The monastery stood scarcely a fortnight against the assault, and the few monks who bothered to surface from their meditations believed the invaders were but demonic visions sent to distract them from meditation. They died where they sat on their silken cushions. Only one youth survived--a pilgrim who had come as an acolyte, seeking wisdom, but had yet to be admitted to the monastery. He watched in horror as the monks to whom he had served tea and nettles were first slaughtered, then raised to join the ranks of the Dead God's priesthood. With nothing but a few of Turstarkuri's prized dogmatic scrolls, he crept away to the comparative safety of other lands, swearing to obliterate not only the Dead God's magic users--but to put an end to magic altogether.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_antimage_hype: Should Anti-Mage have the opportunity to gather his full strength, few can stop his assaults. Draining mana from enemies with every strike or teleporting short distances to escape an ambush, cornering him is a challenge for any foe.

fields.value:
* Stacks additively with other {{M|mana break}} sources.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Conditional}}
*#* Mana Break is a bonus [[conditional attack damage]] source and has the following properties:
*#** The bonus attack damage values corresponds to the actual enemy {{M|mana}} loss upon attack, are directly added to Anti-Mage's attack damage in the {{M|combat log}}, and not displayed on the [[HUD]].
*#** Does not interact with the following sources:
*#*** Percentage-based {{M|bonus attack damage|x}} sources.
*#*** {{M|Allied units|x}}.
*#** Interacts with the following sources:
*#*** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*#**** {{M|Lifesteal}} sources.
*#**** {{M|Critical strike}} sources.
*#**** {{M|Cleave}} sources.
*#*** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*#**** {{M|Damage block}} sources.
*# Anti-Mage's attack instance.
*# {{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|antimage_empowered_mana_break_debuff}}
*#* Applies the following offensive ability effects on the next successful attack on the enemy unit:
*#** Removes {{ValueColor||{{#var:Mana Break type4 value2 agh}}|agh}} max {{M|mana}}.
*#** {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|antimage_empowered_mana_break_debuff}}
*#*** Disables {{M|mana restore}} sources.
*#*** Prevents {{M|mana regeneration}} sources from working utilizing the {{Code|fixed_mana_gain}} property.
<hr>
* {{cf|aghnotes}} Adds a passive component that grants Anti-Mage {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|antimage_empowered_mana_break}} upon {{A|Anti-Mage|Blink}} cast.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_antimage
data.bio_loc: The monks of Turstarkuri watched the rugged valleys below their mountain monastery as wave after wave of invaders swept through the lower kingdoms. Ascetic and pragmatic, in their remote monastic eyrie they remained aloof from mundane strife, wrapped in meditation that knew no gods or elements of magic. Then came the Legion of the Dead God, crusaders with a sinister mandate to replace all local worship with their Unliving Lord's poisonous nihilosophy. From a landscape that had known nothing but blood and battle for a thousand years, they tore the souls and bones of countless fallen legions and pitched them against Turstarkuri. The monastery stood scarcely a fortnight against the assault, and the few monks who bothered to surface from their meditations believed the invaders were but demonic visions sent to distract them from meditation. They died where they sat on their silken cushions. Only one youth survived--a pilgrim who had come as an acolyte, seeking wisdom, but had yet to be admitted to the monastery. He watched in horror as the monks to whom he had served tea and nettles were first slaughtered, then raised to join the ranks of the Dead God's priesthood. With nothing but a few of Turstarkuri's prized dogmatic scrolls, he crept away to the comparative safety of other lands, swearing to obliterate not only the Dead God's magic users--but to put an end to magic altogether.
data.hype_loc: Should Anti-Mage have the opportunity to gather his full strength, few can stop his assaults. Draining mana from enemies with every strike or teleporting short distances to escape an ambush, cornering him is a challenge for any foe.
data.npe_desc_loc: Slashes his foes with mana-draining attacks

abilities.name: antimage_mana_break
abilities.desc_loc: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack and deals damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt.
abilities.lore_loc: A modified technique of the Turstarkuri monks' peaceful ways is to turn magical energies on their owner.
notes_loc: Mana Break has %illusion_percentage%%% mana burn effect if caused by illusions.
abilities.scepter_loc: Increases Max Mana Burned per Hit.

abilities.name: antimage_blink
abilities.desc_loc: Short distance teleportation that allows Anti-Mage to move in and out of combat.
abilities.lore_loc: In his encounter with the Dead Gods, Anti-Mage learned the value of being elusive.
notes_loc: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.
abilities.scepter_loc: After casting Blink, your next Mana Break within %empowered_mana_break_duration%s burns an additional %empowered_max_burn_pct_tooltip%%% max mana and prevents the target from regenerating or gaining mana for a short duration. This debuff is undispellable.

abilities.name: antimage_counterspell
abilities.desc_loc: Passively grants magic resistance. Counterspell may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around Anti-Mage that blocks and reflects any targeted spells.
abilities.lore_loc: With the proper focus, Anti-Mage turns innate resistance into calculated retaliation.
notes_loc: Break disables the passive magic resistance.
abilities.shard_loc: Creates a blinked fragment of Anti-Mage next to the enemy caster upon reflecting their unit-targeted spell while active.
facets_loc: Counterspell burns a percentage of the countered spell's mana cost from its caster and does damage based on %damage_from_mana_drain_percent%%% of the burned mana cost, up to a maximum of %max_damage_from_mana_drain% damage per reflected spell.

abilities.name: antimage_persectur
abilities.desc_loc: Attacks slow enemies based on how much mana they are missing. Min slow at %mana_threshold%%% mana, up to max slow at 0%% mana. No effect if enemy is above %mana_threshold%%% mana.
notes_loc: Full effect if caused by illusions.

abilities.name: antimage_mana_void
abilities.desc_loc: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies.  The main target is also mini-stunned.
abilities.lore_loc: After bringing enemies to their knees, Anti-Mage punishes them for their use of the arcane arts.
notes_loc: Damage is calculated based on the primary target's mana, but applied to all enemies within the area of effect.
facets_loc:
Passively grants attack damage when an enemy hero's mana falls below %min_bonus_pct%%%, with the bonuses increasing as their mana falls further.

If the enemies mana falls below %threshold_pct%%% Anti-Mage gains the maximum amount of damage, as well as vision and True Sight of that hero. Applies to enemy heroes within %thirst_range% range. Bonuses stack per hero.
